item.title: bussilab.notify v0.0.52
item.description: • Added standard Markdown messages from files and options to disable link and media previews. • Added uploading multiple files in one call. File titles now use the supplied title or each file's basename, and threaded uploads include their message correctly. • Validated Slack message, file, and reaction URLs before the corresponding operation, including checks that each operation receives the right URL type. • Separated rate-limit retries from transient-error retries, bounded total wait time, and improved handling of Retry-After and transport errors. • Increased the Screen log limit by using native Markdown blocks and fixed several file-upload edge cases.
item.content:encoded:
• Added standard Markdown messages from files and options to disable link and media previews.
  • Added uploading multiple files in one call. File titles now use the supplied title or each file's basename, and threaded uploads include their message correctly.
  • Validated Slack message, file, and reaction URLs before the corresponding operation, including checks that each operation receives the right URL type.
  • Separated rate-limit retries from transient-error retries, bounded total wait time, and improved handling of Retry-After and transport errors.
  • Increased the Screen log limit by using native Markdown blocks and fixed several file-upload edge cases.
